name: crane-drawing-generator
description: Parametric overhead (EOT) crane drawing generator: inputs -> validated design -> dimensioned 2D SVG, with saved designs in SQLite.

scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
